title: Water Fluoride Test Strip Scanner
problem: Many elderly people in our village walk bent over with severe joint pain, because high fluoride in borewell water damages their bones and teeth.
idea: A test strip reader. We dip a fluoride test strip in the water, show it to the camera, and it tells us if the water is safe to drink. Tap the strip colour to try it.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What does the strip show?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine compares the strip colour with the chart on the test kit. Here, tap the result the camera sees.
widgets.question: The dipped strip matches this part of the kit's colour chart:

options.label: 0 to 1 mg/L
options.result: Low fluoride. This water is within the safe limit for drinking.
options.te: ఫ్లోరైడ్ తక్కువ. ఈ నీరు తాగడానికి సురక్షితం.

options.label: 1 to 1.5 mg/L
options.result: Close to the limit. It is still under 1.5 mg/L, but Mission Bhagiratha or RO water is better.
options.te: పరిమితికి దగ్గరగా ఉంది. మిషన్ భగీరథ లేదా RO నీరు తాగడం మంచిది.

options.label: More than 1.5 mg/L
options.result: HIGH fluoride! Do not drink this water. Use Mission Bhagiratha or RO water.
options.te: ఫ్లోరైడ్ ఎక్కువ! ఈ నీరు తాగవద్దు. మిషన్ భగీరథ లేదా RO నీరు వాడండి.
options.tip: Tell the Panchayat and get the water tested at a government lab.

items.title: Safe limit
items.text: The BIS limit for fluoride in drinking water is 1.5 mg/L.

items.title: Nalgonda story
items.text: Nalgonda district suffered fluorosis for many years because of fluoride in groundwater.
items.te: భూగర్భ జలంలో ఫ్లోరైడ్ వల్ల నల్గొండ జిల్లా చాలా ఏళ్ళు ఫ్లోరోసిస్‌తో బాధపడింది.

items.title: Safe water
items.text: Drink tested water, RO water or Mission Bhagiratha tap water.
items.te: పరీక్షించిన నీరు, RO నీరు లేదా మిషన్ భగీరథ నీరు తాగండి.

items.title: Good food
items.text: Milk, curd and green leafy vegetables help keep bones strong.
items.te: పాలు, పెరుగు, ఆకుకూరలు ఎముకలను బలంగా ఉంచుతాయి.

questions.q: What is the safe limit for fluoride in drinking water?
questions.why: BIS says drinking water should not have more than 1.5 mg/L fluoride.

questions.q: Which part of the body does too much fluoride harm?
questions.why: Fluorosis makes teeth stained and bones stiff and painful.
Boiling does NOT remove fluoride. Use RO or Mission Bhagiratha water.

how: Ask a teacher for a fluoride test kit and test 3 or 4 water samples (borewell, tap, RO).
Open Teachable Machine, choose Image Project and make classes: Safe, Near limit, High.
Take photos of the dipped strips next to the colour chart for each class, then Train and Export.
In Scratch (with the TM2Scratch extension) load the model link.
When class is High, play a siren sound and show 'Do not drink!'.
Ask Gemini to write the warning in simple Telugu and show it to the Panchayat.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student in Telangana. Explain in 5 simple lines (English and Telugu) why high fluoride in borewell water is harmful, what the safe limit of 1.5 mg/L means, and which safe water sources villagers can use.
